deadline.value: December 1, 2026 for fellowships and assistantships; February 1, 2027 for admission without university support.

also.quote: Deadline for all applicants, both Domestic and International, who wish to be considered for University fellowships, teaching assistantships or graduate assistantships.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional and applications without it get full consideration.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required as part of the application process, and applications that do not include a GRE score will be given full consideration for admission.

supervisor.value: An Ecology and Evolution faculty member must agree to be your advisor before admission decisions, and you name 1 to 3 faculty in the application.
supervisor.quote: An advisor is required for admission to the program.

funding.value: Funding (fellowships, TAs, GAs) is considered for applications by December 1; applications by February 1 are considered without university support.
funding.quote: Deadline for all applicants, both Domestic and International, who wish to be considered for University fellowships, teaching assistantships or graduate assistantships. | Deadline for both Domestic and International applicants to be considered for admission without University support.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required to enter the PhD.
entry_route.quote: An M.S. is not required to enter the Ph.D. program.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

notes: Other life-science PhDs at New Brunswick (Microbial Biology, Plant Biology, Entomology, Endocrinology and Animal Biosciences) are separate programs.
